caption: The drawing depicts a woven textile sample composed of rectangular sections with varying geometric patterns. The textile features three main colors: red, green, and off-white, which alternate and combine in different ways across the sections. In the upper left section, the pattern consists of red and green linear and blocky designs on an off-white background. The upper right section displays intricate symmetrical motifs in red and green forming diamond and oval shapes, also on an off-white background. The lower left and right sections contain grid-like patterns in green and off-white, with alternating squares and rectangles. The lower and right edges of the textile are bordered by a band of red and off-white with wavy and grid motifs. The textile sample is mounted on a beige background, and the name "Charles Pondman" is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
